{
  "dataset_name": "postcutoff_prediction_markets_20260517",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "price_range",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Measures the total price movement within the period by subtracting low from high.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "volatility",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows tree models to split on market volatility directly without needing to construct the relationship across multiple nodes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "high - low"
    },
    {
      "name": "relative_open_position",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Calculates where the open price sits relative to the high-low range.",
      "value_range": [-10.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "price_dynamics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a normalized measure of price position, helping trees identify trend direction and price momentum.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(open - low) / np.maximum(high - low, 0.001)"
    },
    {
      "name": "volume_per_trade",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average volume per trade, indicating the typical size of transactions.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 833070.0],
      "feature_family": "liquidity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Helps trees distinguish between retail (many small trades) and institutional (few large trades) activity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "volume / trade_count"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_volume",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed volume to handle extreme outliers.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 14.0],
      "feature_family": "liquidity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces skewness in volume, allowing trees to make more balanced and robust splits across the distribution.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(volume)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_trade_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed trade count to handle right-skewed distributions.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "liquidity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces skewness in trade count, improving split efficiency and preventing a few extreme values from dominating splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(trade_count)"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_extreme_open",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator for open prices near the boundaries of 0 or 1.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "price_dynamics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a direct boolean split for markets that are highly confident in one outcome, which often exhibit different dynamics.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((open < 0.1) | (open > 0.9), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_volume_low_trades",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator for markets with above-average volume but below-average trade count.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "market_microstructure",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Directly flags potential whale activity or block trades, providing a strong categorical split for tree models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((volume > 3734.0) & (trade_count < 10.0), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "platform_1_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean indicator for platform 1.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "categorical_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows trees to isolate platform-specific behaviors without relying on ordinal splits of categorical IDs.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(platform_id == 1.0, 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "platform_2_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean indicator for platform 2.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "categorical_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows trees to isolate platform-specific behaviors without relying on ordinal splits of categorical IDs.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(platform_id == 2.0, 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "market_activity_level",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of market activity level based on volume and trade count, categorized into ordinal buckets (0=inactive, 1=low, 2=medium, 3=high).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "liquidity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a clean ordinal feature for trees to split on overall market engagement, abstracting away raw volume noise.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "price_direction_momentum",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of implied price momentum based on the relationship between open, high, and low prices, scored from 0 to 10.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "price_dynamics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures complex non-linear price dynamics that might require multiple tree splits to approximate using raw features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "liquidity_profile",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of market liquidity based on the combination of volume, trade count, and price range, scored from 0 to 5.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "market_microstructure",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic view of market depth, helping trees identify markets prone to slippage or manipulation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
